# Solven Advisory

> Solven Advisory trains private equity teams on AI, builds it into their workflows, and runs AI projects in their portfolio companies that lift EBITDA. Augmentation without cognitive atrophy.

Solven trains private equity teams on AI, builds it into their workflows, and runs projects across their portfolio companies that lift EBITDA. The people making the call still own the reasoning behind it.

- Based in Lisbon, Portugal. Solven Advisory, Lda.
- Book a 30-minute call: https://solvenadvisory.ai/book
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/solven-advisory
- The site is in English and in European Portuguese (https://solvenadvisory.ai/pt).

## Four ways we work with a firm

- **Enablement**: Hands-on sessions on the leading AI platforms for the whole firm, analyst to managing partner, run monthly because the frontier moves weekly.
- **Build**: Agents and workflow systems on the fund's own work: contract redlining, IC memo interrogation, portfolio reporting.
- **Portfolio**: For any portfolio company, in any sector: we find what is holding back EBITDA and fix it, with AI where it helps and without it where it does not.
- **Token Economics**: Where the compute spend goes, what it returns, and how to pace it so the year's budget lasts the year.

## Augmentation without cognitive atrophy

- **Judgment is the product.** In an investment firm the deliverable is a defensible decision; AI should make that judgment sharper, never thinner.
- **Fluency is firm-wide.** From the newest analyst to the managing partner, everyone should know where AI belongs in their own work, and where it does not.
- **The portfolio is where it pays.** Whatever its sector, every portfolio company has a part of the business holding it back. We start from that problem, not from the technology.

## Pages and insights

- [Home](https://solvenadvisory.ai/): Solven Advisory trains private equity teams on AI, builds it into their workflows, and runs AI projects in their portfolio companies that lift EBITDA. Augmentation without cognitive atrophy.
- [Insights](https://solvenadvisory.ai/insights): Short notes from Solven Advisory on AI in private equity, real estate and venture firms: what we see in the work, and what it means for partners.
- [Book a call](https://solvenadvisory.ai/book): Book thirty minutes with a Solven Advisory co-founder, by video or phone.
- [Privacy](https://solvenadvisory.ai/privacy): How Solven Advisory handles the personal data of the people who write to us or book a call, and which cookies run only after you accept them.
- [Editors of drafts they cannot defend](https://solvenadvisory.ai/insights/editors-of-drafts-they-cannot-defend): Why the real risk in AI rollouts is cognitive offloading, not adoption failure, and how inverting the workflow keeps investment analysis defensible.
- [How to tell whether the AI is real](https://solvenadvisory.ai/insights/how-to-tell-whether-the-ai-is-real): A working method for AI diligence: where the model comes from, what surrounds it, what breaks when a provider changes terms, and what engineers can show live.
- [Making every token earn its place](https://solvenadvisory.ai/insights/making-every-token-earn-its-place): Why AI spend behaves nothing like software licences, and how workflow-level costing, from cost per memo to cost per data room, turns tokens into a P&L partners can read.

## Em português

- [Início](https://solvenadvisory.ai/pt): A Solven Advisory forma equipas de capital de investimento em IA, integra-a nos seus fluxos de trabalho e implementa projetos de IA nas empresas do seu portfólio que aumentam o EBITDA. Ampliar capacidades, preservando o pensamento crítico.
- [Insights](https://solvenadvisory.ai/pt/publicacoes): Notas curtas da Solven Advisory sobre IA em fundos de private equity, imobiliário e venture capital: o que vemos no nosso trabalho, e o que isso pode trazer para os sócios.
- [Marcar uma chamada](https://solvenadvisory.ai/pt/marcar): Marque uma reunião de trinta minutos com um dos cofundadores da Solven Advisory, por vídeo ou por telefone.
- [Privacidade](https://solvenadvisory.ai/pt/privacidade): Como a Solven Advisory trata os dados pessoais de quem nos escreve ou marca uma chamada, e que cookies só funcionam depois de os aceitar.
- [Editores de rascunhos que não conseguem defender](https://solvenadvisory.ai/pt/publicacoes/editores-de-rascunhos-que-nao-conseguem-defender): Porque é que o verdadeiro risco da IA é delegar o raciocínio, e não a adoção falhar, e como inverter o fluxo de trabalho mantém a análise de investimento defensável.
- [Como saber se a IA é real](https://solvenadvisory.ai/pt/publicacoes/como-saber-se-a-ia-e-real): Um método de trabalho para a due diligence de IA: de onde vem o modelo, o que o rodeia, o que deixa de funcionar quando o fornecedor muda as condições e o que os engenheiros mostram ao vivo.
- [Fazer cada token valer o que custa](https://solvenadvisory.ai/pt/publicacoes/fazer-cada-token-valer-o-que-custa): Porque é que a despesa com IA não se comporta como as licenças de software, e como o custeio por fluxo de trabalho, do custo por memorando ao custo por data room, transforma tokens num P&L que os partners conseguem ler.
